verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment kept separate from production data is a fair axis for an AI platform with an API, Console and connected data sources, so the story applies. The pack never documents such a sandbox, test mode or isolated environment. The 'run code' mention describes code execution, not a dry-run or isolated test environment separate from production data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
